59: /-- A relation is confluent when its reflexive transitive closure has the diamond property. -/
60: abbrev Confluent (r : α → α → Prop) := Diamond (ReflTransGen r)

62: /-- A relation is semi-confluent when single and multiple steps with common origin
63:   are multi-joinable. -/

65:   ∀ {x y₁ y₂}, ReflTransGen r x y₂ → r x y₁ → Join (ReflTransGen r) y₁ y₂
66: 
67: /-- A relation has the Church Rosser property when equivalence implies multi-joinability. -/
68: abbrev ChurchRosser (r : α → α → Prop) := ∀ {x y}, EqvGen r x y → Join (ReflTransGen r) x y

70: /-- An element is reducible with respect to a relation if there is a value it is related to. -/

77: /-- An element is normal if it is not reducible. -/

81: abbrev Normalizable (r : α → α → Prop) (x : α) : Prop :=
82:   ∃ n, ReflTransGen r x n ∧ Normal r n
83: 
84: /-- A relation is normalizing when every element is normalizable. -/
85: abbrev Normalizing (r : α → α → Prop) : Prop :=
86:   ∀ x, Normalizable r x

88: /-- An element `x` is `SN` (for strongly-normalising) for a relation `r` if it is accessible under
89: the inverse of `r`. -/
90: abbrev SN (r : α → α → Prop) := Acc (fun a b => r b a)

92: /-- A relation is acyclic if its transitive closure is irreflexive, equivalently if it admits no

96: /-- A relation is terminating when the inverse of its transitive closure is well-founded.

98: abbrev Terminating (r : α → α → Prop) := WellFounded (fun a b => r b a)

101: abbrev Convergent (r : α → α → Prop) := Confluent r ∧ Terminating r
102: 
103: /-- A relation is locally confluent when all reductions with a common origin are multi-joinable -/
104: abbrev LocallyConfluent (r : α → α → Prop) :=
105:   ∀ {a b c : α}, r a b → r a c → Join (ReflTransGen r) b c

109:   ∀ {x y₁ y₂}, r x y₁ → r x y₂ → ∃ z, ReflGen r y₁ z ∧ ReflTransGen r y₂ z

112: def Commute (r₁ r₂ : α → α → Prop) := ∀ {x y₁ y₂},
113:   ReflTransGen r₁ x y₁ → ReflTransGen r₂ x y₂ → ∃ z, ReflTransGen r₂ y₁ z ∧ ReflTransGen r₁ y₂ z

116: def StronglyCommute (r₁ r₂ : α → α → Prop) :=

119: /-- Generalization of `Diamond` to two relations. -/

49:   | I

`a` rewrites to both `b` and `c`, then `join r` relates `b` and `c`
(see `Relation.church_rosser`).
-/
def Join (r : α → α → Prop) : α → α → Prop := fun a b ↦ ∃ c, r a c ∧ r b c

section Join

open ReflTransGen ReflGen

/-- A sufficient condition for the Church-Rosser property. -/
theorem church_rosser (h : ∀ a b c, r a b → r a c → ∃ d, ReflGen r b d ∧ ReflTransGen r c d)
    (hab : ReflTransGen r a b) (hac : ReflTransGen r a c) : Join (ReflTransGen r) b c := by
  induction hab with
  | refl => exact ⟨c, hac, refl⟩
  | @tail d e _ hde ih =>
    rcases ih with ⟨b, hdb, hcb⟩
    have : ∃ a, ReflTransGen r e a ∧ ReflGen r b a := by
      clear hcb
      induction hdb with
      | refl => exact ⟨e, refl, ReflGen.single hde⟩
      | @tail f b _ hfb ih =>
        rcases ih with ⟨a, hea, hfa⟩
        cases hfa with
        | refl => exact ⟨b, hea.tail hfb, ReflGen.refl⟩
        | single hfa =>
          rcases h _ _ _ hfb hfa with ⟨c, hbc, hac⟩
          exact ⟨c, hea.trans hac, hbc⟩
    rcases this with ⟨a, hea, hba⟩
    cases hba with
    | refl => exact ⟨b, hea, hcb⟩
    | single hba => exact ⟨a, hea, hcb.tail hba⟩

theorem le_join_of_refl [Std.Refl r] : r ≤ Join r :=
  fun _ b hab ↦ ⟨b, hab, refl b⟩

@[deprecated (since := "2026-06-30")] alias join_of_single := le_join_of_refl

  symm _ _ := fun ⟨c, hac, hcb⟩ ↦ ⟨c, hcb, hac⟩

  refl a := ⟨a, _root_.refl a, _root_.refl a⟩

@[deprecated (since := "2026-06-10")] alias reflexive_join := Join.refl

theorem isTrans_join [IsTrans α r] (h : ∀ a b c, r a b → r a c → Join r b c) :
    IsTrans α (Join r) :=
  ⟨fun _a b _c ⟨x, hax, hbx⟩ ⟨y, hby, hcy⟩ ↦

  @reflTransGen_of_isTrans_reflexive _ _ _ _ _ hr.stdRefl hr.isTrans

open Relation

variable {r : α → α → Prop} {a b : α}

theorem Quot.eqvGen_exact (H : Quot.mk r a = Quot.mk r b) : EqvGen r a b :=
  @Quotient.exact _ (EqvGen.setoid r) a b (congrArg
    (Quot.lift (Quotient.mk (EqvGen.setoid r)) (fun x y h ↦ Quot.sound (EqvGen.rel x y h))) H)

theorem Quot.eqvGen_sound (H : EqvGen r a b) : Quot.mk r a = Quot.mk r b :=
  EqvGen.rec
    (fun _ _ h ↦ Quot.sound h)
    (fun _ ↦ rfl)
    (fun _ _ _ IH ↦ Eq.symm IH)
    (fun _ _ _ _ _ IH₁ IH₂ ↦ Eq.trans IH₁ IH₂)
    H

theorem Equivalence.eqvGen_iff (h : Equivalence r) : EqvGen r a b ↔ r a b :=
  Iff.intro
    (by
      intro h
      induction h with
      | rel => assumption
      | refl => exact h.1 _
      | symm => apply h.symm; assumption
      | trans _ _ _ _ _ hab hbc => exact h.trans hab hbc)
    (EqvGen.rel a b)

  funext fun _ ↦ funext fun _ ↦ propext <| h.eqvGen_iff

end EqvGen
